question: Does the PIDS irrigation assessment or a bounded search provide fish inventory evidence that can be assigned to Vaca Dam Reservoir, Llanera?
decision: No species-by-waterbody fish inventory was found in the reviewed material. PIDS supplies historical downstream water-quality context only. The 2021 CLSU stocking report covers Paitan Lake and Vaca Dam Reservoir together and gives no site allocation; it remains an introduction-event lead, not a fish occurrence inventory.

waterbody.identityAndExtent: The name and municipal association are reported in CLSU material. This review does not establish an authoritative reservoir boundary, upstream/downstream delineation, fishing access, or geometry.

newSource.title: Revitalizing Philippine Irrigation: A Systems and Governance Assessment for the 21st Century
newSource.relevantLocation: Chapter 2, National Irrigation Systems, printed page 58; indexed text lines 1853-1869.
newSource.finding: The report says dissolved oxygen fell below its stated 6 mg/L good-water-quality cutoff at some locations, including downstream of Vaca Dam, and attributes the condition to thick aquatic vegetation upstream of the dam. This is a historical downstream irrigation-water measurement context, not a reservoir fish survey or a current safety result.
newSource.methodsContext: The report says Luzon system data were collected in the 2015 field cycle and describes field measurements of water-quality parameters at selected system sections. No fish sampling, fish taxon, fish specimen, Vaca measurement coordinate, or exact Vaca station date is supplied in the reviewed passage.
limits: Downstream-of-dam water-quality context does not identify taxa in the reservoir or prove a fish occurrence.
The report's historical measurement must not be displayed as current water safety, fish-safety, or present dissolved-oxygen guidance.
The report does not establish the reservoir's legal or physical boundary.
newSource.reuse: No item-specific reuse grant was identified. No figure, photograph, table, or extended text was retained.

priorSourceChain.finding: The 2021 CLSU notice reports one stocking activity for both Paitan Lake and Vaca Dam Reservoir. It lists counts of Nile tilapia, mudfish, and carp jointly without assigning any species or count to one waterbody.
priorSourceChain.finding2: The Silliman Nueva Ecija study sites include Paitan Lake and Pantabangan Dam, not Vaca Dam Reservoir. Paitan fish findings are not transferred to Vaca.

boundedSearch.result: The reviewed results surfaced the already-known CLSU joint stocking notice and PIDS irrigation/water-quality material. Several name-matched results referred to the unrelated Vaca Dam in Belize. No independent, site-resolved Vaca reservoir fish survey or specimen record was located in this bounded search.
boundedSearch.scopeCaveat: A bounded web search is not proof that no Vaca fish survey or specimen record exists.

nextStep: Continue the Central Luzon freshwater source sweep. Prioritize independently dated fish surveys, museum vouchers or occurrence records with a Vaca-specific site link; keep the 2021 stocking report unallocated and the PIDS downstream water-quality finding historical and non-fish context.
